Bash(ssh root@89.116.214.130 'K=$\(docker ps -q -f name=kommodb_db | head -1\); P\(\) { docker exec -i $K psql -U kommo -d kommo_dashboard -At "$@"; }; echo "--- etapas do receita_qtd"; P -c "select \\"KommoStageId\\", \\"Name\\", \\"PipelineName\\" from kommo_stages where \\"KommoStageId\\" in \(106037739,106037747,108773168\)" 2>&1 | head; P -c "select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name='\\''kommo_stages'\\''" | tr "\\n" " "; echo; echo "--- leads vinculados \(tabela leads\)"; P -c "select \\"Id\\", left\(\\"Name\\",22\), \\"CurrentStage\\", \\"CurrentStageId\\", \\"TreatmentPlanValue\\", \\"TreatmentBudget\\", \\"Price\\", \\"ClosedTreatment\\" from leads where \\"Id\\" in \(23164791,23296919,13011678,19867849,23944063,23113029,13012226,13004450,23833965\)" 2>&1; echo "--- campo 2440829 no lead José Cavalcante"; P -c "select e->>'\\''name'\\'', e->>'\\''value'\\'' from leads l, lateral jsonb_array_elements\(l.\\"CustomFieldsJson\\"\) e where l.\\"Id\\"=23113029 and \(e->>'\\''name'\\'' ilike '\\''%valor%'\\'' or e->>'\\''name'\\'' ilike '\\''%plano%'\\'' or e->>'\\''name'\\'' ilike '\\''%tratamento%'\\'' or e->>'\\''id'\\''='\\''2440829'\\''\)" 2>&1 | head -12; echo "--- tabela treatments"; P -c "select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name='\\''treatments'\\''" | tr "\\n" " "; echo; P -c "select count\(*\) from treatments where \\"UnitId\\"=15" 2>&1 | head -2')

Bash(ssh root@89.116.214.130 'K=$\(docker ps -q -f name=kommodb_db | head -1\); P\(\) { docker exec -i $K psql -U kommo -d kommo_dashboard -At "$@"; }; echo "--- colunas de leads"; P -c "select column_name from information_schema.columns where table_name='\\''leads'\\'' order by ordinal_position" | tr "\\n" " "; echo; echo "--- etapas do receita_qtd"; P -c "select \\"StatusId\\", \\"StatusName\\", \\"PipelineName\\" from kommo_stages where \\"UnitId\\"=15 and \\"StatusId\\" in \(106037739,106037747,108773168\)"; echo "--- leads vinculados por KommoLeadId"; for col in KommoLeadId KommoId ExternalId; do P -c "select \\"Id\\", \\"$col\\", left\(\\"Name\\",22\), \\"CurrentStage\\", \\"CurrentStageId\\", \\"TreatmentPlanValue\\", \\"TreatmentBudget\\", \\"Price\\" from leads where \\"$col\\" in \(23164791,23296919,13011678,19867849,23944063,23113029,13012226,13004450,23833965\) and \\"UnitId\\"=15" 2>/dev/null && break; done; echo "--- AppConfigurations chaves"; P -c "select \\"Key\\" from \\"AppConfigurations\\" where \\"Key\\" ilike '\\''%admin%'\\'' or \\"Key\\" ilike '\\''%key%'\\''" | head')
